706970101.text: #{NICKNAME}! What a surprise, running into you in Mondstadt!

706970102.text: I've never been anywhere with a climate like this before. It's so cold! But wow, what an experience!

706970103.text: I've had my first snowball fight, built my first snowman... Oh, and the comics are a nice surprise!

706970104.text: The Soulblazer Saga is super popular in Inazuma, but I totally wasn't expecting to find so many people that read it.

706970105.text: I had a great chat with some Natlanese fans earlier. It really got me inspired, so... I ended up making a character stand.

706970106.text: ...Oh, sorry, lemme backtrack a little. Have you ever heard of The Soulblazer Saga?

706970107.text: You tell Yoimiya about the Legion of Soulblazers...

706970108.text: No way! Your friends are into it too? What a funny coincidence.

706970109.text: In that case, lemme give you this character stand of Fietena. Hehe, she'll be right at home in the Legion of Soulblazers!
